text: Not sure if I'm overthinking this, I'm shattered. Nephew, 5, temp 38.8 tonight. He was sick once around tea time but he's kept all his drinks down since, no more of that. When the calpol or nurofen kicks in he's back to himself, playing with his cars and chatting non stop, drinking fine. I did panic for a second when I got him changed because his legs were covered in purple marks, turns out he'd been drawing on himself with his felt tips, it all came off with a baby wipe, so that's not it lol. I think he's ok? Just want to check if I need to do anything else or just keep alternating
